component.name: gmpublisher Steventechno Edition
component.summary: Browse, extract, pack and publish Garry's Mod addons

developer.name: Steventechno, based on gmpublisher by William Venner

description.p: gmpublisher was created by William Venner, and all credit for it goes to him. The Steventechno Edition is a Linux-first rewrite for SteamOS, Bazzite and other Linux desktops, built with Rust and KDE's Kirigami.

ul.li: Browse your installed Garry's Mod addons and Workshop downloads
Publish, update and edit your Steam Workshop items
Download and extract any Workshop addon

description.p: Steam must be running and signed in for the Workshop features.
